observation.visible_scene: A calm lakeside landscape: a dense green tree line with a small house partly hidden among the trees runs along the far shore, mirrored in a glassy lake that fills the lower half of the frame; a blue sky with scattered white clouds is reflected in the water, and tall reeds/grasses occupy the right foreground, also reflected at the bottom-right. The camera framing (horizon, tree line, house, reed edge) is identical across all frames, indicating a fixed viewpoint.
visible_changes: The overall composition is essentially static throughout the ~3.3 s excerpt; no object translates across the frame and there is no detectable camera pan, tilt, or zoom.

The only change is very subtle: the mirror image of the trees, sky, and especially the foreground reeds in the water shows slight, slow shifts in ripple/distortion pattern between frames (e.g. the reed reflection at bottom-right looks marginally more broken in some frames than others), consistent with gentle surface motion on an otherwise still lake.
The standing reeds on the right and the tree canopy show no clearly visible sway; the clouds in the sky do not show measurable drift between the first and last frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the faint reflection shimmer continues, intensifies, or settles beyond this cropped window is not shown.
Any wind or wave activity strong enough to move the reeds or trees is not evident within the excerpt and remains unknown.
uncertain_details: The minute differences in the water reflection are small and could partly be compression/rendering noise rather than true ripple motion; the magnitude of surface movement is uncertain.
Whether the clouds or reeds exhibit any real micro-motion is not reliably distinguishable from frame-to-frame artifacts.
